title.zh: 在AI攻克数学问题的一年里，Anthropic或许刚解决了最大的那个
title.en: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest

summary.zh: Anthropic一名数学家称，他利用AI证明了著名的黎曼猜想。该证明尚需一段时间才能完成验证，若成立将是数学界的重大突破。
summary.en: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis. Verification will take some time, and if confirmed the result would be a landmark in mathematics.

reports.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude

title.zh: AI宣称解决167年历史的黎曼猜想，人类也给出了答案
title.en: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too

summary.zh: 数学家们对最新由AI取得的研究结果感到震惊，与此同时，也出现了与之竞争的人类解法。目前该结果仍需数学界进一步验证与评议。
summary.en: Mathematicians are reeling from a new AI-driven result on the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, and a competing human solution has surfaced as well. Both claims still await scrutiny from the mathematics community.

reports.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too

title.zh: Anthropic登陆华尔街开始交易
title.en: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street

summary.zh: Anthropic正式上市，以股票代码“ANT”在纳斯达克挂牌，开盘价111.50美元，高于每股83美元的发行价；按发行价计算公司估值约1.5万亿美元。此次上市距其公布IPO计划约一个月。
summary.en: Anthropic went public on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT," opening at $111.50 a share, up from its $83 IPO price, which had valued the company at roughly $1.5 trillion. The listing comes about a month after the company announced its plans.

reports.title: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street

title.zh: 英伟达股价暴跌14%，创2008年金融危机以来最长周线连跌
title.en: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

summary.zh: 英伟达股价单日下跌14%，录得2008年金融危机以来最长周线连跌。这家曾经的全球市值第一公司现已退居第四，落后于苹果、微软和Alphabet。
summary.en: Nvidia shares fell 14%, capping their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis. Once the world's most valuable company, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

reports.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

title.zh: AI交易崩跌引发踩踏：金银铜全线重挫，金价跌超9%、纽铜跌近10%，原油三周跌两成
title.en: AI Trade Collapse Sparks Stampede: Gold, Silver and Copper Slump; Gold Down Over 9%, NY Copper Nearly 10%, Oil Off 20% in Three Weeks

summary.zh: AI相关交易大幅回撤并引发连锁抛售，黄金、白银、铜价全线重挫，金价跌幅超过9%，纽约铜价下跌近10%，原油三周内累计下跌约两成。
summary.en: A sharp unwind in AI-linked trades set off a broad selloff across commodities, with gold falling more than 9%, New York copper nearly 10% and crude oil down roughly 20% over three weeks.

reports.title: AI交易崩跌踩踏！金银铜全线重挫，全周期金跌超9%、纽铜跌近10%，原油三周大跌两成 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: AI抛售拖累Anthropic上市第二日，纳斯达克回吐2026年全部涨幅
title.en: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic's second day of trading

summary.zh: Anthropic上市第二日股价下跌，带动美股走低，纳斯达克综合指数回吐2026年全部涨幅，较年初收盘跌5%，道指与标普500进入回调区间。投资者质疑AI基建巨额投入。
summary.en: Anthropic's stock fell on its second trading day, dragging the wider market lower. The Nasdaq Composite erased all its 2026 gains, closing 5% below its January 1 level, while the Dow and S&P 500 ended in correction territory.

reports.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading

title.zh: 独家：消息人士称英伟达会计问题成为美国SEC调查重点
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社独家报道，消息人士称美国证券交易委员会（SEC）正在调查英伟达，会计问题是调查重点。报道未披露更多细节。
summary.en: Reuters exclusively reported, citing sources, that Nvidia’s accounting is a focus of a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission investigation. The report provided no further details.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say - Reuters
英伟达再遭SEC调查，会计问题是审查重点，股价已较10月高点腰斩 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 特朗普威胁对在境外建AI数据中心的企业征收“巨额税收”
title.en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US

summary.zh: 特朗普表示将对在美国境外建设数据中心的企业征收“巨额税收”，并称不会允许本国企业在国外建数据中心。与此同时，美国多州和城市正限制新建数据中心的申请。
summary.en: President Donald Trump vowed a "tremendous tax" on companies building data centers outside the US, saying he won't allow American firms to do so abroad. The threat comes as states and cities impose restrictions on new data center applications.

reports.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad
Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
Trump vows to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, threatens 'tremendous tax'

title.zh: Frostbite：一款由AI设计并验证的全新CPU架构
title.en: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI

summary.zh: 相关博客介绍了名为Frostbite的新CPU架构，该架构由AI完成设计并经过验证。该话题在技术社区引发大量讨论。
summary.en: A new blog post introduces Frostbite, a CPU architecture that was discovered, designed and verified by AI. The project drew heavy discussion in the tech community.

reports.title: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI

title.zh: Inkling 2 Mini 发布
title.en: Inkling 2 Mini

summary.zh: Thinking Machines 发布名为 Inkling 2 Mini 的新产品，相关消息在 Hacker News 上获得约 811 分和 137 条评论，讨论热度较高，但公开信息有限。
summary.en: Thinking Machines published a news post titled "Inkling 2 Mini." The item drew roughly 811 points and 137 comments on Hacker News, though public details remain limited.

reports.title: Inkling 2 Mini

title.zh: 语言模型能够改写自身权重
title.en: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

summary.zh: 一篇新论文探讨让语言模型自行改写权重的方法，被视为模型自我改进方向的研究进展。该文在 Hacker News 上获得约 364 分和 114 条评论。
summary.en: A new arXiv paper explores methods that let language models rewrite their own weights, a step toward model self-improvement. The paper drew about 364 points and 114 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋风波余波未平
title.en: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues

summary.zh: 在CEO黄仁勋被罢免事件的余波中，英伟达本周发布财报，业绩增长稳健，并承诺好景将持续。公司同时表示将停止在中国销售H200芯片，并拒绝了相关诉求。
summary.en: Amid fallout from the ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia reported healthy earnings growth and promised the good times will continue. The chipmaker also said it will stop selling its H200 chips in China and dismissed calls to do otherwise.

reports.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues

title.zh: Signal 阻止 Gemini 与 Siri 读取用户屏幕
title.en: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

summary.zh: Signal 在安卓和 iOS 上限制截图功能，以防 AI 智能体读取用户消息等数据。Signal 总裁称，操作系统内置的、通过分析屏幕内容了解用户的 AI 能力，正在削弱 Signal 独立保障隐私的能力。
summary.en: Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS to stop AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. Its president said OS-level AI that analyzes on-screen content undermines Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy.

reports.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

title.zh: 限制移动操作系统上的 AI 智能体抓取数据
title.en: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data

summary.zh: Signal 发布博客文章，说明为何要限制移动平台上的 AI 智能体抓取用户数据，并介绍其隐私保护措施。该文在 Hacker News 上获得约 528 分和 310 条评论。
summary.en: Signal published a blog post explaining why it is restricting AI agents on mobile platforms from capturing user data, and outlining its privacy protections. The post drew about 528 points and 310 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data

title.zh: 加州调查英伟达芯片出口是否流入中国
title.en: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

summary.zh: 加州总检察长邦塔向英伟达发出调查传票，调查其先进半导体出口是否违反美国限制流入中国，并称相关丑闻“亮起明显红灯”，将查明公司是否误导投资者。此前联合创始人兼长期CEO黄仁勋已离职。
summary.en: California's attorney general issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia over whether its advanced chips reached China in breach of US restrictions. Rob Bonta said the scandal "raises bright red flags" and will examine whether the company misled investors.

reports.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

title.zh: 苹果或在研发可操控Mac的自有AI智能体
title.en: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

summary.zh: 据报道，苹果似乎正在构建AI智能体，可与Meta Muse、Instinct、Claude和OpenAI Dots等产品竞争，未来或能代用户操作Mac。目前细节尚未公布。
summary.en: Apple appears to be building AI agents that could compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude and OpenAI Dots, potentially operating a Mac on the user's behalf. Details remain sparse.

reports.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

title.zh: Mac 版 Gemini 现在可以操控你的电脑
title.en: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

summary.zh: 谷歌为 macOS 版 Gemini 应用加入“电脑操作”能力，可跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步骤任务。谷歌举例称其可用于加速工作流、填写表单、制作演示文稿和发布二手商品信息。
summary.en: Google's Gemini app for macOS now supports computer use, letting it complete multi-step tasks across local files, desktop apps and the web. Google cites faster workflows, form filling, presentations and listing items for sale as use cases.

reports.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

title.zh: 中俄美达成和平宣言，未提及乌克兰与伊朗战争
title.en: China, Russia and US agree peace declaration with no mention of Ukraine and Iran wars

summary.zh: 中俄美在史无前例的三边峰会后发表和平宣言，列出联合国改革、增加石油供应和“保护外交豁免”等优先事项，但未提及由其中两方参与的乌克兰和伊朗战争。
summary.en: After an unprecedented trilateral summit, China, Russia and the US issued a peace declaration listing priorities including UN reform, higher oil supplies and protection of diplomatic immunity. It made no mention of the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

reports.title: China, Russia and US agree peace declaration with no mention of Ukraine and Iran wars

title.zh: 丹麦指俄策划暗杀美国-乌克兰说唱歌手
title.en: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper

summary.zh: 丹麦指控俄罗斯策划暗杀一名美国-乌克兰说唱歌手，俄驻丹麦使馆否认指控。此事导致俄罗斯国防武官被驱逐。
summary.en: Denmark accused Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper. The Russian embassy in Denmark denied the allegation, and Russia's defence attaché was expelled.

reports.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper

title.zh: Zscaler股价大涨18%，因报道称CrowdStrike正洽谈收购该安全厂商
title.en: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor

summary.zh: 有报道称CrowdStrike正洽谈收购一家网络安全厂商，Zscaler股价应声上涨18%。在AI时代，网络安全公司正积极通过并购扩张能力。
summary.en: Zscaler shares rose 18% after a report that CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire the security vendor. Cybersecurity companies have been actively pursuing acquisitions to expand capabilities in the AI era.

reports.title: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor

title.zh: AI 领域最被误解的图表迎来重大更新
title.en: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

summary.zh: METR 更新其广受关注的 AI“时间跨度”图表。报告称部分 AI 能力仍沿指数轨迹提升，但模型在需要判断力的任务上不如编程任务。
summary.en: METR has updated its widely cited AI time-horizon chart. It finds some AI capabilities still improving exponentially, but models are weaker at judgment-heavy tasks than at coding.

reports.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

title.zh: 伯纳姆：英欧达成协议后将探索更紧密关系
title.en: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham

summary.zh: 英国与欧盟周五达成协议，涵盖英国食品出口、碳排放交易和青年交流计划。伯纳姆表示，英国将在此基础上探索与欧盟更紧密的联系。
summary.en: The UK and EU agreed a deal on Friday covering British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme. Burnham said Britain will explore even closer ties with the EU after the agreement.

reports.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham

title.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点
title.en: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls 10 Basis Points

summary.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率单日下跌10个基点，显示市场对利率路径和经济前景的预期出现调整，资金流向避险资产。
summary.en: The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note dropped 10 basis points in a single session, signaling shifting expectations for interest rates and the economic outlook as investors moved toward safer assets.

reports.title: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点 - 第一财经

title.zh: 为何 iOS 上仍没有非 WebKit 浏览器
title.en: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

summary.zh: Mozilla 发文解释苹果 iOS 的浏览器内核规则，说明为何至今仍无基于其他内核的浏览器上架。该文在 Hacker News 上获得约 338 分和 202 条评论，引发对平台开放性的讨论。
summary.en: Mozilla published a post on Apple's iOS browser engine rules, explaining why no non-WebKit browsers exist on the platform. It drew about 338 points and 202 comments on Hacker News, reviving debate over platform openness.

reports.title: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

title.zh: Google 正推动 OEM 厂商反对 GrapheneOS 与 bootloader 解锁
title.en: Google is pushing OEMs against GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking

summary.zh: GrapheneOS 称 Google 正推动 OEM 厂商限制 GrapheneOS 与 bootloader 解锁。相关讨论在 Hacker News 引发大量关注。
summary.en: GrapheneOS says Google is pushing OEMs to restrict GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking. The claim drew significant discussion on Hacker News.

reports.title: Google is pushing OEMs against GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking

title.zh: 联合国秘书长角逐凸显大国分歧
title.en: Race to be next UN secretary general exposes divisions among world powers

summary.zh: 联合国安理会即将投票，可能决定哥斯达黎加热门候选人是否遭大国阻挠。若其受阻，关于安理会五常主导地位的争论可能再起。
summary.en: A UN Security Council vote is likely to show whether the Costa Rican frontrunner for UN secretary general will be blocked by major powers. If so, debate over the dominance of the P5 could reignite.

reports.title: Race to be next UN secretary general exposes divisions among world powers

title.zh: PostgreSQL 19
title.en: PostgreSQL 19

summary.zh: PostgreSQL 19 已发布，官方版本说明页面同步上线。该数据库新版本发布引发开发者社区关注。
summary.en: PostgreSQL 19 has been released, with official release documentation now available. The major database update drew attention from the developer community.

reports.title: PostgreSQL 19

title.zh: 马姆达尼宣布计划2032年前关闭纽约赖克斯岛监狱
title.en: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032

summary.zh: 马姆达尼宣布计划在2032年前关闭纽约赖克斯岛监狱。该监狱关闭计划可追溯至2019年，但因囚犯安置地点问题而延迟。
summary.en: Mamdani announced a plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032. Efforts to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, but delays arose over where to place inmates.

reports.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032

title.zh: 法国警察因殴打音乐制作人泽克勒被判刑
title.en: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler

summary.zh: 法国法院对殴打黑人音乐制作人米歇尔·泽克勒的警察作出判决。法院认定种族主义是2020年殴打事件的加重情节。
summary.en: A French court sentenced police officers for the 2020 beating of Black music producer Michel Zecler. The court treated racism as an aggravated circumstance in the beating.

reports.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler

title.zh: 为什么中国不愿成为世界下一个气候领导者
title.en: Why China is unwilling to be the world's next climate leader - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社以此为题报道中国不愿接棒成为全球气候领导者的立场及其原因。报道聚焦中国在全球气候治理中的角色选择；现有原文仅提供标题。
summary.en: Reuters reports on why China is unwilling to become the world’s next climate leader. The available source provides only the headline, limiting further detail.

reports.title: Why China is unwilling to be the world's next climate leader - Reuters

title.zh: “虚弱又头晕”：ICE秘密强制喂食手段终结古巴父亲绝食
title.en: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike

summary.zh: 一名被关押在得州ICE拘留中心的古巴寻求庇护者称，强制喂食带来的痛苦迫使他结束绝食。他向《卫报》描述，若不进食就会被插管喂食，目前仍虚弱头晕。
summary.en: A Cuban asylum seeker in an ICE detention center in Texas said the pain of force-feeding forced him to end his hunger strike. He told the Guardian that refusal to eat led to tube-feeding and that he remained weak and dizzy.

reports.title: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike

title.zh: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？｜电厂
title.en: What Has BYD Been Doing in Japan? | Power Plant

summary.zh: 界面新闻“电厂”栏目梳理比亚迪在日本市场的布局，涉及电动巴士投放、乘用车销售与渠道建设等进展，分析中国车企进入日本市场的路径与挑战。
summary.en: Jiemian's Power Plant column reviews BYD's expansion in Japan, covering electric buses, passenger car sales and dealership build-out, and assesses the challenges Chinese automakers face in that market.

reports.title: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？ | 电厂 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 技术故障引发批评后特朗普撤换网络安全主管
title.en: Trump ousts cyber director after tech outages spark criticism - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，在技术故障引发批评后，特朗普撤换了网络安全主管。报道未提供更多细节。
summary.en: Reuters reported that Trump ousted the cyber director after tech outages sparked criticism. The report did not provide further details.

reports.title: Trump ousts cyber director after tech outages spark criticism - Reuters

title.zh: 景顺长城黎海威：AI长期主线不变，但决定科技行情的还是盈利答卷
title.en: Invesco Great Wall's Li Haiwei: AI remains the long-term theme, but earnings will decide the tech rally

summary.zh: 景顺长城基金经理黎海威表示，人工智能仍是长期投资主线，但科技板块行情能否持续，最终取决于企业盈利能否兑现。文章提示投资者关注业绩验证而非单纯的概念炒作。
summary.en: Invesco Great Wall fund manager Li Haiwei says artificial intelligence remains a long-term investment theme, but the durability of the tech rally ultimately depends on companies delivering earnings. He urges investors to focus on profit verification rather than concept hype.

reports.title: 景顺长城黎海威：AI长期主线不变，但决定科技行情的还是盈利答卷 - 第一财经

title.zh: 美国食肉螺旋蝇病例激增，牧场主保持警惕
title.en: Flesh-eating screwworm cases surge in US, keeping ranchers on alert - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，美国食肉螺旋蝇病例出现激增，牧场主因此保持警惕。此类害虫可侵害牲畜，给畜牧业带来风险。
summary.en: Reuters reports a surge in flesh-eating screwworm cases in the United States, keeping ranchers on alert. The pest can harm livestock and poses risks to the agricultural sector.

reports.title: Flesh-eating screwworm cases surge in US, keeping ranchers on alert - Reuters

title.zh: 相隔大西洋的两个天才｜AI历史①
title.en: Two Geniuses Across the Atlantic | AI History, Part 1

summary.zh: 财新推出“AI历史”系列首篇，讲述分处大西洋两岸的两位天才人物，追溯人工智能思想的早期源流。文章以人物为线索，梳理AI发展史上的关键思想脉络。
summary.en: Caixin launches its AI History series with a piece on two geniuses on opposite sides of the Atlantic, tracing the early intellectual roots of artificial intelligence. The article uses their stories to map key threads in AI's development.

reports.title: 相隔大西洋的两个天才｜AI历史① - 财新

title.zh: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记
title.en: An Abandoned Seaside Paradise on the Black Sea | Caucasus Notes

summary.zh: 财新“高加索散记”系列的一篇游记，描写黑海沿岸一处被废弃的度假胜地，记录当地旅游业由盛转衰的痕迹与现状。
summary.en: A Caixin travel essay from its Caucasus notebooks describes an abandoned resort on the Black Sea coast, tracing the rise and decline of the local tourism economy.

reports.title: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记 - 财新

title.zh: AI 或已攻克数学中最重要的难题
title.en: AI may have solved the most important problem in mathematics

summary.zh: 人类为证明黎曼猜想已耗费 167 年，如今有报道称人工智能可能破解了这一悬而未决的难题。若结论成立，素数分布理论乃至密码学等诸多领域都将受到影响。值得深入阅读，是因为目前仍属宣称阶段，其证明是否经得起检验才是关键。
summary.en: Humans have spent 167 years trying to prove the Riemann hypothesis. Reports now suggest AI may have cracked math's most important open problem. If confirmed, the result would touch number theory, cryptography and much else. It is worth reading to see how far the claim has actually been checked.

title.zh: 独立数学家认定：AI 辅助的黎曼猜想证明几乎肯定成立
title.en: The AI Riemann hypothesis proof is almost certainly true, independent mathematicians attest

summary.zh: 数学家正在完成对一项宣称解答的核查；该解答针对的是数学界最重要的未解难题。独立同行的初步判断是，这份 AI 辅助证明几乎可以肯定正确。值得深入阅读，因为它展示了数学结论如何被逐行验证，以及 AI 参与的研究正如何进入同行评审流程。
summary.en: Researchers are close to finishing their verification of a claimed solution to the most important unsolved problem in math. Independent mathematicians say the AI-assisted proof is almost certainly correct. It is worth reading for a look at how such claims are actually checked, line by line, before they are accepted.

title.zh: 黎曼猜想证明出现互相竞争的声明
title.en: Dueling claims of Riemann hypothesis proofs emerge

summary.zh: 在 AI 辅助破解数学界最著名难题的重磅消息发布仅数小时后，第二份证明声明随即出现。多方同时宣称解决同一猜想，牵出优先权、署名与验证程序等问题。值得深入阅读，以观察数学界如何处理围绕同一著名难题的竞争性宣告。
summary.en: Mere hours after a blockbuster announcement of an AI-assisted solution to the most famous problem in math, a second claim has emerged. Competing proofs raise questions of priority, credit and verification. It is worth reading to see how the mathematics community handles dueling announcements over a single celebrated conjecture.

title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆的欧盟协议只是起点
title.en: Andy Burnham’s EU deal is only a start

summary.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆与欧盟达成的协议被视为起点，而非终点；难点在于后续扩大适用范围将十分困难。文章指出，这一扩张障碍正是当前的核心问题。值得深入阅读，以了解英国地方政治人物在对欧关系中可操作的空间与限制。
summary.en: Andy Burnham's EU deal is being framed as a beginning rather than an end. The trouble is that widening it will be difficult, and that difficulty is the real problem. It is worth reading to understand the political and practical limits facing UK regional leaders who seek closer EU ties.

title.zh: “我精于欺骗”：一名复饮酗酒者的隐秘生活（播客）
title.en: ‘I perfected deception’: My secret life as a relapsed alcoholic – podcast

summary.zh: 作家梅根·奥吉布林讲述自己在戒酒 11 年后复饮的经历：身边人都知道她过去的成瘾史，而这一次连丈夫也不知情。文章由凯特·汉福德朗读。值得深入阅读，因为它细致呈现了成瘾、隐瞒与坦白之间的心理拉扯，以及“欺骗”如何成为生活的一部分。
summary.en: Writer Meghan O'Gieblyn describes relapsing into alcoholism after 11 years sober, and how she hid it this time, even from her husband. Everyone knew about her earlier addiction; no one knew about this one. Read by Kate Handford. It is worth reading for a candid, carefully crafted first-person account of secrecy and disclosure.
